description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to payments in an insurance management system, specifically request payloads for paying premiums and claim payouts.

classes.name: PaymentDtos
classes.description: Container class for payment-related Data Transfer Objects (DTOs).

classes.name: RecordPremiumPaymentRequest
classes.description: DTO for recording a premium payment, containing customer and payment details.

classes.name: RecordClaimPayoutRequest
classes.description: DTO for recording a claim payout, including claim and payment details.
